tooltip.starcrowndoll.place: Right-click a block: place the doll
tooltip.starcrowndoll.lore: Mortal or immortal, all shall acknowledge your divinity.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill1: I: Mortal! I grant you the right to behold the sun.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill1.effect: Wear to enable a server-owned unbounded life pool. Hearts are display health.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill1.protect: Guards damage, direct health edits, death, and standard entity removal.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill2: II: God! Bear witness to human will.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill2.travel: Creative flight, night vision, and +50% sprint speed.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill2.build: 3x mining, no flying mining penalty, and +3 block reach.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill2.immune: Rejects harmful/neutral effects and knockback; clears fire and freezing.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill3.effect: Suspends mob AI in a 7x7x7 area while worn. Restores on exit; excludes players.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.music: Right-click to loop music and freeze, bounce and spin mobs within 16 blocks. Right-click again or break the doll to release them.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.yule.animation: Palm display, blinking and head sway; arms rise on jumps and lower on landing.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.white_rice.effect: Grants Instant Health XXIX (level 29) when eaten
tooltip.starcrowndoll.yule.feast: While music plays, living creatures and players within 16 blocks eat rice every 1.6 seconds, gaining Instant Health XXIX. Stops outside range or when music ends.
